parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Odufor (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Odufor
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: 1.24 m – 17.04 m (main aquiferous zone in Layer 3, high-resistivity coarse sand/gravel), with a possible secondary water-bearing zone below 17.04 m in Layer 4
Recommendation: Case off the shallow low-resistivity clay/topsoil (0–1.24 m) to prevent caving and contamination, and set screens within the 1.24–17.04 m sand/gravel interval; drilling may be extended past 17.04 m to confirm and tap the deeper Layer 4 sand for increased yield.
